definitions.avg_util: pool busy time / (span × workers_in_pool) — the run-average reference
definitions.bin: one equal-width time segment (fine view, 200 bins over the run span)
definitions.capacity: bin_width × workers_in_pool — the denominator making util a 0-1 fraction
definitions.metric: mean fraction of a pool's workers busy computing in each time bin
definitions.note: a unified worker runs its replica in lockstep across its GPUs, so worker-busy ≡ GPU-busy and the fraction reads as per-GPU utilization
definitions.scope: all cost_log iterations, grouped by pool
